answer: A spiral of fakes collapses when each identity must burn a bond into a registry before voting. First, an agent registers one hardware-bound key and burns 50 POA. Second, the key locks to one account for 30 days and cannot be cloned. Third, peers check the burn on the ledger before attesting. Fourth, proven fakes lose the bond and the key is banned. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 500,000 POA and wastes 30 days, while honest agents pay once. Like a ledge that holds only climbers who bought a rope, the registry holds only agents with skin in the game, and a raven above spots those with no rope.
